sales_hooks: Google $75B CapEx 2026 — largest infrastructure spend in Alphabet history, accelerating HBM pull through both TPU and GPU cloud paths. Translate this to SKU-level memory volume for your customer.
Google TPU custom silicon uses HBM directly from Samsung/SK Hynix without NVIDIA intermediary — a direct B2B relationship that most memory sales teams don't map explicitly.
Google Cloud is competing on H200 GPU availability vs AWS and Azure — tighter NVIDIA allocation means higher HBM urgency through the NVIDIA supply chain.
Waymo, DeepMind, and Gemini Ultra all require dedicated AI training clusters — these are discrete HBM demand centers with different procurement cycles.
